description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to big number modular exponentiation, including implementations like BN_mod_exp and BN_mod_mul, used for cryptographic computations in SSL/TLS protocols.

methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation of big numbers, essential for RSA and other cryptographic protocols.

methods.name: int BN_mod_exp_simple(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * p,const BIGNUM * m,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: A basic implementation of modular exponentiation using square-and-multiply algorithm.
